headline: Anisha Berlia files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Texmaco Rail & Engineering
sum: Anisha Berlia has made a substantial acquisition in Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited, triggering mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4). The disclosure was submitted to NSE by V Venugopalan on behalf of the acquirer on 19 June 2026.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, any person acquiring 5% or more of a company's voting rights must disclose within two trading days (Regulation 31(4)). The filing by Anisha Berlia indicates a substantial increase in shareholding in the Texmaco Rail group company. The exact acquisition percentage, consideration amount, and acquisition date are not disclosed in the Bar & Bench article but are contained in the PDF filing itself.
